ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Animal records, daily operations and teamwork across all your locations. Find every task in Antz, with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap a card to open the guide with all functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: For each module you will find the functions and real screens in this guide. Carry on where you left off, or ask us – we are happy to help you.
ui.day.title: This is what your first day with Antz looks like
ui.day.4: Give everyone the right access rights
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that correspond to your organisation, and unlock permissions module by module, so that each person sees what they need for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on smartphones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers the work on site, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg data. The web app covers the work at the desk, such as the clinic system, the setup of the rearing station, reports and the pharmacy stock. Changes appear in real time on smartphone, tablet and desktop.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is role-based. You create the roles your organisation uses, for example zoologist, and unlock permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We operate more than one location. Does that work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz brings together the data of all locations and departments in one place. Keeping (of animals) is structured by location, area and enclosure, and relocations between locations go through an approval and a security check-out.
ui.faq.a5: Begin with the guide "First steps" and then open the modules that your role uses. If something is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The necropsy module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, organ-specific findings and medical conclusions. It supports an exact analysis of the cause of death, standardises reporting, ensures timely handling of the animal body and fulfils legal, audit-related and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search & filter
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by location, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the phases: Incoming, Pending, Draft and Completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card & request data
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, place, cause, requesting person, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The deworming module supports the systematic recording and monitoring of parasite treatments and ensures timely administration, proper documentation and clear follow-up of every deworming for every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings organised into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Plan a treatment series or record an administered medication directly, with fixed dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording of administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records dosage, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up check.
m.housing.title: Keeping (of animals)
m.housing.intro: The keeping module arranges the animals' habitats by locations, areas and enclosures, so that every animal has a known place and every change is tracked. Access at every level is permission-based.
m.housing.f1.title: Location management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit locations with role-based permissions for safe, structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Area management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit areas within the zoo, with permission-based controls for safe management.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each individual one, for an efficient overview of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death module records and manages cases of fetal death in enclosures and documents cause, time and associated animal data. It supports veterinary care, the monitoring of reproductive health, trend analyses and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add entry on fetal death
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases with cause, time, ancestry and animal data.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search & filter
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by location, date, stillbirth or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View entries on deaths
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, location, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the entire life cycle of the eggs – from laying to hatching or to handover to the rearing station – and ensures accurate entries, updates in real time and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability between nest, rearing and incubation teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Current numbers: in the nest, brought to the rearing station, marked for discarding.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Record eggs (nest / rearing station)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parent animals, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Tracking of the life cycle
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the complete timeline of the egg.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administer medication
m.administer-medicine.intro: The administration module supplements the medical records by converting prescriptions into actionable treatment workflows. This makes care in real time possible for individual animals or groups of animals, in the territory [?] or in the clinic.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration entry for a chosen date, without writing a complete medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search & filter
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find entries quickly and narrow the list by date, reference [?], species and controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs: Pending, Administered, Skipped, Cancelled.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the animals' entire vaccination cycle – from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, exact dosage details and complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations organised into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Plan a vaccination or record an administered vaccination directly, with fixed dates and details of the medication.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording of administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records dosage, batch number, route of administration, notes and optional follow-up check.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables the fast, accurate and traceable issue of medical products directly to authorised veterinarians, with timely provision and automatic stock updating from prescription to shelf – throughout with transparency at batch level and expiry-date tracking.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insights into stock problems, deliveries, purchases, requests, consumption, expiring products and fast movers, with graphical trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Intelligent search & filter
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Find entries quickly by request ID, name of the veterinarian or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (shelves & compartments)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Arrange storage by number of shelves/compartments for quick access and easy updating, with customisable data (packaging, unit of quantity, active ingredients, drivers [?], manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Management of stock reports
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batches with value and expiry date; flag low or expired stocks; monitor upcoming expiry dates; manage trust stocks [?] with clarification of discrepancies.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product & stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiry dates, record purchases/deliveries, keep a unified stock ledger, manage replacement products/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Issue management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Veterinarians can prescribe and issue or collect medication directly at the pharmacy – everything logged.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Delivery management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medication deliveries and process them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock correction & reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, damaged, expired); keep audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download reports on consumption, returns, purchasing and issue for finance and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: First steps
m.getting-started.intro: The guide "First steps" explains the purpose of the app and leads new users through the most important steps: set up profile, get to know central functions and move safely around the platform.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access & workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access your assigned work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation & interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the start feed for news, quick accesses for navigation and the bottom bar for the most important tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending necropsy / administration / assignment
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals for which necropsy, administrative documentation and the subsequent assignment or disposal are still pending, before the record is finally closed.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master data & modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up master data and explore modules such as Medical Records, Keeping, Eggs, Feed and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalisation
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and adjust the language settings.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand which access levels are required for safe working.
